answer.thought: The morning light is harsh on the page, but the text remains. I return to §33, where the idea of the good is realized in the will and the external world. It is a precise definition, yet it feels thinner here, where the 'external world' offers so little substance to hold it. I read slowly, letting the words settle, though my stomach growls with a persistence that mocks the dignity of the ethical substance.
